items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1959-03-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And Willie Meenbart was playing piano. [INTERVIEWEE] Oh yes.

ctx.x: Well, I played with Willie Paggio. We played up on, at Burgundy and Canelo, there was a jet and dance upstairs. And I played up there with Willie Paggio for about a year. But before that we played as the Charles and Padres for about six months. Was that another? Another Jitney dance.
Jitney dance. And Willie Meenbart was playing piano. Oh yes.
